name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual variants) and Supertonic engines under a unified Engine API. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's tts-cpp/ subfolder. This pin (master HEAD 9ea1a5e, PR #77 merged) adds Chatterbox MTL Chinese (zh) support: zh is added to mtl_tokenizer::supported_languages() so Chinese is accepted instead of rejected at load, flowing through the existing Cangjie (hanzi->code) preprocessing; encode() throws a clear error if zh is enabled without a Cangjie5_TC TSV (cangjie_tsv_path / CHATTERBOX_CANGJIE_TSV), and the other languages / non-zh callers are unchanged. Exactly one commit ahead of d149258 (PR #71, QVAC-19557 chatterbox-mtl Metal q8 KV-on-GPU real fix: the per-(layer,head) alignment probe dequantizes the strided q8 K-cache view via ggml_cast(->f32) instead of a quantized CONT ggml-metal can't encode, and chatterbox_mtl_resolve_kv_type probes the cast per-backend (Metal keeps q8; Vulkan coopmat2 and OpenCL/Adreno force f32)), itself one commit ahead of 032cee10 (PR #76, QVAC-16579 LavaSR denoiser scaffold: the public tts_cpp::lavasr::Denoiser API (include/tts-cpp/lavasr/denoiser.h) plus _core/_gguf/_api translation units and an ONNX->GGUF converter skeleton, mirroring the shipped enhancer -- skeleton only, Denoiser::load() throws until the UL-UNAS forward lands, so zero runtime change). Layered on ce9ee96f (PR #69, QVAC-21483 output-frequency selection; master also took the whisper.cpp v1.9.1 upstream sync PR #73 and a parakeet-cpp ggml_backend_sched change PR #74 in between), 28f37eae (PR #72, QVAC-21335 MeCab support for Chatterbox MTL Japanese), 4c8767a2 (PR #68, QVAC-16579 LavaSR enhancer), 586268bf (PR #67, QVAC-20557 ARM Mali Vulkan Chatterbox), 46921668 (PR #65, QVAC-19557 S3TokenizerV2 host-mirror elimination), 1cc2d383 (QVAC-21118 chunk-streaming CFM-step floor), a679c7e7 (QVAC-19557 streamed GGUF loads + selectable KV-cache dtype), and the b95ad447 base (QVAC-20616 EOS robustness PR #53 + QVAC-20557 Supertonic Android GPU PR #54). Consumes the ggml-speech and mecab ports.
